evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

scenario_reconstruction.method: The scenario input tuple is not present anywhere in the permitted evidence tree (grep for 'syndra_custom_order', 'custom_order', 'manual_target' over data/ and docs/math-foundations.md returns nothing; data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json contains no Syndra scenario). Scenario semantics were therefore recovered from the champion's option surface as recorded in the cached audit data.
scenario_reconstruction.id_decoding: 'syndra' + custom cast order + '60' = the splinters option set to 60. data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json (Syndra): 'E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres).' data/champion-audit/batch-6.json (Syndra): 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff'.
scenario_reconstruction.limitation: Level, AP, target resistances and the cast order itself are outside the evidence tree, so this receipt verifies the CHANGE (its sign, its size, and which game rule can produce it) rather than re-deriving 5648.4 from scratch inputs. Both candidate reconstructions below reproduce the observed delta to within 0.03.

game_rules_quoted.quote: Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
game_rules_quoted.note: Threshold is 'collecting 40', i.e. splinters >= 40. At splinters = 60 this bonus IS live; the thresholds are cumulative, not banded.
rank-5 Dark Sphere = 230 + 70% AP magic damage.

game_rules_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.

game_rules_quoted.note: Decoded: true = (0.12 + 0.0002*AP) * (base_r + 0.65*AP). Checks: 0.12*190 = 22.8 (rank-5 flat, exact); 0.12*0.65 + 0.0002*190 = 0.116 = 11.6% AP (rank-5 AP coefficient, exact); 190 + 22.8 = 212.8 and 65 + 11.6 = 76.6 (Total Mixed row, exact). The third listed modifier (constant 1.14 '% AP' at every rank) is the known-degraded parse of the AP-squared cross term (0.0002*0.65 = 0.013% per AP, i.e. 1.3% AP per 100 AP).

game_rules_quoted.quote: E: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath ... increased scatter angle and slow' (utility, no damage). R: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath ... execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health.' P: 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.'
game_rules_quoted.note: At splinters = 60 the 80 / 100 / 120 bonuses must NOT be live; the 100-splinter execute is documented as not modeled (batch-6.json: 'the fight target never dies').
Used to convert raw magic damage to post-mitigation damage; true damage bypasses this factor entirely.
At L=18 the bracket is exactly 1.0, so Syndra AD = 54 + 2.9*17 = 103.3 (rounded 103 by the documented 'Stat rounding ... APPROX' row). Used when testing auto-attack decompositions.

independent_computation.claim: At splinters = 60 exactly two damage-bearing Transcendent bonuses are game-live: the 40-splinter Dark Sphere charge (an extra Q cast) and the 60-splinter Force of Will true damage. A model that reports LESS damage at 60 splinters is omitting one of them. The golden move is upward by exactly 650.0 (+13.0%), i.e. damage was restored, not invented.

candidate_reconstruction_1.mechanic: 40-splinter stocked Dark Sphere charge -> one additional rank-5 Q cast (dropped by a banded threshold at splinters = 60, restored by the fix)
candidate_reconstruction_1.arithmetic: Q5 = 230 + 0.70 * AP; with AP = 600 and an unmitigated manual target (MR = 0, m(0) = 100/100 = 1): 230 + 420 = 650.0
candidate_reconstruction_1.note: This is the only (AP, MR) pair with integer AP (per the documented display-rounding convention) for which one extra Q cast equals exactly 650.0; the sweep over MR = 0..200 pinned AP = 600, MR = 0.

candidate_reconstruction_2.mechanic: 60-splinter Force of Will bonus true damage newly applied at the exact boundary (>= 60 vs > 60)
candidate_reconstruction_2.note: Recovered by a joint sweep over AP in 0..1300 and MR in 0..200 requiring both endpoints to be reproduced by an abilities-only cast multiset; the only fits were AP = 854, MR = 54/56, 3 W casts, i.e. the delta is exactly the 60-splinter true-damage term.

independent_computation.both_candidates_agree: Either way the added 650 is damage the cached wiki text mandates at 60 splinters, so the higher number is the game-correct one.

elimination_of_old_value_correct.hypothesis: the change wrongly applied the 120-splinter Transcendence buff (+15% AP) at 60 splinters
elimination_of_old_value_correct.test: That buff scales only the AP-derived portion of damage: delta = 0.15 * AP_portion. delta = 650 requires AP_portion = 4333.3 = 86.7% of the 4998.4 baseline.
elimination_of_old_value_correct.result: Impossible. Syndra's AP share of a rotation (Q 70% / W 65% / E 60% / R sphere 20% AP against flat bases 230/190/200/160, plus zero-AP auto attacks) is 66% at AP 854 and still only 74% at AP 1200; 86.7% needs AP > 2500. Hypothesis rejected.
elimination_of_old_value_correct.second_hypothesis: the change applied the 100-splinter R execute at 60 splinters
elimination_of_old_value_correct.second_result: Rejected: the execute is health-threshold based (below 15% max health), would not land on a round 650, and is documented as not modeled ('the fight target never dies', data/champion-audit/batch-6.json).

independent_computation.conclusion: No mechanism consistent with the cached wiki text produces 4998.4 as the correct total at splinters = 60; every mechanism that produces the +650 move is a bonus the wiki says is live at 60.

confidence: high on direction and rule (the 40- and 60-splinter bonuses are both live at splinters = 60 and the only over-application candidates are numerically excluded); medium on which of the two mechanics supplied the 650, since the scenario's input tuple is outside the permitted evidence tree.
